THE MAIN PRODUCT

Hard Maple. A serious industrial hardwood.

Our commercial focus is Canadian Hard Maple logs—not finished lumber, not rotary-cut veneer. Species and grade are evaluated against each buyer's manufacturing requirements.

CORE OFFERING

Canadian
Hard Maple

Sugar Maple (Acer saccharum). Raw logs for manufacturers who process timber into their own products.

Canadian Hard Maple

Acer saccharumPublic listing⌄

Grain / texture

Fine, mostly straight; sometimes wavy or figured.

Skateboard decks, rotary veneer, flooring, cabinetry and worktops.

PROCUREMENT PROCESS

A precise enquiry makes for a better quotation.

We gather technical requirements for qualified buyers and coordinate an availability and quotation request with the supplier. No quantity, price, certification, freight rate or delivery date is guaranteed in advance.

1

Describe your production use

Species, log type, grade and intended processing.

2

Set volume and dimensions

Diameter, length, approximate monthly containers and tolerances.

3

Confirm destination and commercial terms

Import country, destination port and preferred Incoterm.
